verification: serial contains ESP32_S3_DEVKITC1_V11_RMT_OK after firmware observes RMT CH0_TX_END

gaps.detail: No power net drives the MCU; VDD is assumed to be an ideal rail, so power-on and brown-out reset are not simulated.

scope_note: The hosted verifier compiled the direct-register RMT sequence on a bare ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1-N16R8 diagram and asserted the marker emitted only after CH0_TX_END. The diagram did not include a WS2812 component, so hosted verification does not assert pixel color; the local repository smoke separately checks the decoded red pixel. This is simulated model evidence, not hardware confirmation.
